risks.risk: Wrong alternator variant/part number (even within the same engine family) leading to connector/fitment mismatch.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the alternator label/part number (including any Valeo/OEM number) and the connector type; ideally also a photo of the mounting ear(s) and pulley end.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used alternator with possible fitment/connector mismatch risk.

risks.risk: Electrical failure not visible in photos (diode/regulator/rotor/stator issues).
risks.proof: Bench test results (alternator output voltage/current and ripple) or a video of it charging on a vehicle with a multimeter reading.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed working (worst case: needs repair/doesn’t charge).

risks.risk: Pulley/bearing wear or noise (common alternator failure) not detectable from still images.
risks.proof: Video of the pulley spinning by hand and/or a short running video showing no wobble/whine; also photo of the bearing/pulley side.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with unknown bearing condition.

risks.risk: Brush/regulator condition (brush length, regulator health) cannot be confirmed from the provided angles.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the brush/regulator area (or a photo after opening the regulator/brush holder) and/or test results.

Video of pulley spin (no wobble/no grinding) and a quick running sound check.
